title: Deployment manifest (SPEC section 12)
description: Versioned JSON at config/deployments/<chainId>/<lowercase draw address>.json, composing the section 15 Chain, Asset, Price, VRF and Ownership records with the deployed facts. A mainnet manifest may reference no mock artifact. Addresses are lowercase, uint256 values are decimal strings and every hash is 0x-prefixed lowercase hex.

codeHash.description: keccak256 of the deployed runtime code. Writes are blocked on missing or mismatched deployment code (ACCEPTANCE U15).

deployTx.description: Null when the deployment transaction hash is not recoverable, as with some local broadcast modes.

pendingOwner.description: Ownable2Step pending owner; the zero address when no transfer is pending.

constructorArgs.description: Declared here because a subschema's additionalProperties cannot see a property added by the schema that references it. Only the Draw record carries it; the Vault record forbids it.

upkeepRecord.description: The optional Chainlink Automation executor (contracts/src/LuckyDrawUpkeep.sol, SPEC section 10.3, ADR 039). Absent means the deployment's lifecycle is driven by the operator keeper alone, which is a valid deployment. The contract has no owner and no pending owner, so this record carries neither. Registration and LINK funding are operator steps in the Chainlink Automation app: `registry` and `upkeepId` stay null until they are done, and the registry address for a chain is looked up by the operator, never guessed.

draw.description: The immutable DRAW the executor is bound to. Rule D28 requires it to equal contracts.draw.address.

registry.description: The Chainlink Automation registry this upkeep is registered with, recorded by the operator from the registration receipt. Null, or the zero address, until registration.

upkeepId.description: The registry's upkeep id as a decimal string. Null until registration.

drawConstructor.description: The exact LuckyDraw constructor arguments (contracts/src/LuckyDraw.sol). Every VRF parameter is constructor-fixed; the validator checks each against the vrf record.

initialOwner.description: Owner at construction, usually the deployer. The final owner is reached through the two-step transfer, so this need not equal ownership.finalOwner.

toolchain.description: The pins from contracts/foundry.toml (SPEC section 12). The validator checks these against the committed foundry.toml.

listed.$comment: Constrained in asset.schema.json#/$defs/assetCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

poolId.$comment: Constrained in asset.schema.json#/$defs/poolConfig; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

firstRoundIds.$comment: Constrained in asset.schema.json#/$defs/poolConfig; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

deploymentId.description: `${chainId}:${lowercase Draw address}` everywhere: API, caches, keeper and manifest (SPEC section 10.3).

constructorArgs.$comment: Constrained in $defs/contractRecord; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

release.description: Whether this deployment is open to customers, and the private mainnet shakedown that is the only thing allowed to open it (SPEC section 14). Optional: an absent release object means customerLaunch false.

customerLaunch.description: True once the operator has played the shakedown and is ready to share the link. The Pages build refuses to publish a mainnet manifest with this false.

anyOf.description: The private mainnet shakedown: the operator alone plays one daily round end to end and one refund path, and records the measured numbers here.

roundIds.description: Round ids the shakedown played, in the order they were played.

callbackGasUsed.description: Callback gas measured on mainnet. The pre-deploy vrf.measuredCallbackGasUsed is the Foundry number; this one is the observed one. Zero is not a measurement: a callback that ran wrote storage and emitted. The validator additionally rejects a value above vrf.callbackGasLimit (rule D27).

requestToFulfilmentSeconds.description: Seconds from requestDraw to fulfilment, measured on mainnet. The fulfilment lands whole confirmations later, so zero is not a measurement.

costPerDrawNativeWei.description: Native wei spent per draw, keeper gas plus the payment in the coordinator's RandomWordsFulfilled event. Never "0": a draw pays the coordinator's premium and the keeper's gas.

shakedown.description: Null until the shakedown is played.

mocks.description: Artifact names of the labeled mocks this deployment uses. Must be empty outside the local environment: a mainnet manifest may reference no mock artifact (SPEC section 12).
